question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Knack
solution:
The opposite of **knack **is **inability**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Knack **means a natural skill or talent for doing something.
 
• **Inability **means the lack of ability or skill to do something.
 
• Therefore, inability is the opposite of knack.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vile **means extremely unpleasant or disgusting, which is not related to knack.
 
• **Process **means a series of actions or steps taken to achieve a particular end, which is not opposite to knack.
 
• **Lesson **means a period of learning or teaching, which is not opposite to knack.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• It is important to note that the **opposite of a word depends on the context** in which it is used.
 
• In this case, the opposite of **knack **is **inability **because it refers to the ability or skill to do something.
 
• However, in a different context, the opposite of knack could be a different word.
